No material blocker is identified.","model_case":"A projected 0.39 assists on about 16.7 minutes makes a single assist a minority outcome. The weakness is that the shrunk production rate assumes his recent role holds. Power-play usage is unverified, so a lighter role would erode the margin.","price_case":"This is a single 0.5 line at +280. The model's fair price is near +207 and its minimum acceptable price near +242. The blended case also clears break-even, though the market sits close to the model. Only one other book is quoted, so consensus is thin.","context_case":"The table shows no Protas listing, which does not confirm health. Game starts 12:40 p.m. EST.","blocking_checks":[]},"countercase":"The median outcome is zero assists, and the probability gap over the market is small. Florida's injuries may already be priced into Washington's team totals.","open_checks":["Reconfirm +280 is still available before puck drop","Check morning line rushes for Protas's line and power-play spot","Note the Florida starter once announced"],"evidence":[{"source_id":"6850ce03dd8e05c592e8","excerpt":"Aleksander Barkov (C); Knee; IR. Expected to be out until at least Nov 27","interpretation":"If Barkov is out, Florida's defensive play may weaken, modestly helping Washington's scoring chances. The prop-level effect is uncertain.","kind":"injury","direction":"context","represented_in":"unknown"}]}]}
